caseName: City of Fulton v. Public Service Commission
caseNameFull: City of Fulton v. Public Service Commission of Missouri, etc.
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Missouri.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Pawhuska v. Pawhuska Oil Co., 250 U. S. 394. See Chicago v. Dempcy, 250 U. S. 651. Mr. Eugene C. Brockmeyer and Mr. John Robison Baker for plaintiff in error. Mr. James D. Lindsay for defendants in error.
